requirements.requirement: Preflight, draft publication and exact source/destination identity
requirements.evidence: source-inspected; B2 (T/publications.py) publishes a Bitbucket folder's task on Ready after a zero-effect preflight (names, exact local head, every remote view binding the repository, one frozen push route, this host's claim, the repository, base and branch on Bitbucket, every open pull request from the branch read in full): a push leased on what Bitbucket said the branch holds, a draft opened from exactly that commit into the task's base, then ready for review at that commit after its checks are read in full; another base, two open, or another operation's pull request refuse with nothing sent (test/test_bitbucket_publication.py authored, CI pending); Bitbucket's real answers are native qualification

requirements.requirement: Frozen push route and truthful post-effect facts without stale task overwrite
requirements.evidence: source-inspected; B2 pushes only to the one push URL git derives, which no insteadOf/pushInsteadOf rule rewrites again, re-reads the remote's views as the last check before the push and each write, pushes create-if-absent first and then only from this host's own recorded last push (one atomic ref update with that exact expectation, so no one's commits are dropped), saves each push's operation id before git runs and settles one git didn't answer for from the branch next time, and keeps a confirmed push in this host's claim whatever fails later, shown by show and --json (test/test_bitbucket_publication.py authored, CI pending); a real push and Git credential are native qualification

requirements.requirement: Durable exact UUID, no blind retry, positive-same-UUID reconciliation
requirements.evidence: source-inspected; B2 saves each write's operation UUID as uncertain (synced) before it is sent, sends it once, and confirms it only on positive exact evidence: one open pull request from the branch into its base at the head sent, whose description carries that same id (and, for ready, draft off); an empty or failed lookup or a changed remote keeps it uncertain and Ready sends nothing that changes anything; 401/403 and a budget stop before sending are refusals (test/test_bitbucket_publication.py authored: lost reply found at once and on reopening with one POST, empty lookups held, uncertain preparation; CI pending); a delayed write landing later and Bitbucket's real answers are native qualification

requirements.requirement: Canonical claim exclusion across execution machines
requirements.evidence: source-inspected; B2 excludes per Bitbucket repository and task branch through the server's ref transaction: the task branch's first push is create-if-absent (--force-with-lease=<ref>: with the claim's operation id saved first), so one push creates it; a host that never pushed an existing branch refuses read-only, and only the branch's owner opens, adopts or prepares its pull request; one host's claims file and lock also exclude its own folders, tasks and commands; a third party pushing the branch first blocks publication; no shared store (service/store.ts unused) (test/test_bitbucket_publication.py authored: two simulated hosts on one bare repository and the fixture Bitbucket, read after and racing with the same and another commit, one branch creation and one pull request; CI pending); Bitbucket's own git server and two real hosts are native qualification
